description: The fatal open again, with the numeric branch of Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS this time. OPEN INPUT at app/cbl/CBCUS01C.cbl:L120 reports '35' - the classic 'the file was not available' status - and because both of its bytes are digits and the first is not '9', L162's class condition is false and the paragraph takes its ELSE arm at L170-L172: '0000' with the two status characters overlaid at one-based positions three and four, giving FILE STATUS IS: NNNN0035. That is a different branch of the same paragraph case08 drives, and only a case whose status is numeric can reach it. The dataset is declared holding two records deliberately: the run must abend in the open without reading either of them, so a translation that opened lazily and read first would emit two extra pairs of lines.

expectedMessages.text: START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBCUS01C
